samples.identification: Self-named NanoCoreUltimate spyware and destructive locker; internal name cakhiatvvt.live_nano.exe
evidence: Main calls BlockInput(true), Defender-disable commands, shadow deletion, ms-settings DelegateExecute/fodhelper hijack, and persistence installation
StartKeylogger installs hook 13 and polls keys 1..255; HookCallback buffers window-attributed keystrokes; FlushKeylog writes records through SendToC2
Main starts screenshot, clipboard, credential-store and browser-file collection, removable-drive self-copy/autorun, and system-DLL append attempts
Main schedules CreateBackdoorAccount, which passes separate user-create and administrator-add arguments to Process.Start("net", ...)
ProcessHollowing creates suspended svchost, attempts unmap, writes NOP/NOP/NOP/RET, changes Eip and resumes the thread
limitations: IsPlaceholder always returns true and ParseC2Url empties the domain: SendToC2 logs locally and returns before HTTP; DNS task is gated too
AES key and IV are 17 and 15 bytes, so encryption throws before output replacement or original deletion; target is Desktop/TestFolder
DumpLSASS opens a process handle and reports access; it does not dump process memory
WormSpread only copies locally; not evidence of network propagation. Hollowing writes a stub, not a replacement PE image
Self-assigned malware-family names and mutexes do not establish NanoCore, WannaCry, GlassWorm or Ngrbot lineage
samples.trait_changes: Neutral injection profile replaces hostile API-only hollowing; add notable account arguments and hostile keylogger/account composite
